method: Congruent interlaced equilateral triangles with one parallel groove family per triangle, reconstructed from complementary photographs. No photographed brightness becomes height. Body and bars are traced in TCGdex print coordinates.
estimates: Triangle side (30 print pixels), 30-degree lattice rotation, lattice phase, groove pitch (2.3 print pixels), depth and the leg contour obscured by the GX banner are estimates guided by the photographs.
